notes.title: Echoes III - New Update Released!
notes.notes:
Today we've release a new version that improves game performance and fixes a few issues:

[list]
[*]Fixed a possible crash when too many objects on screen
[*]Speedrun Achievement unlock logic fixed
[*]Long Leaderboard names cropped (24 chars max)
[/list]

We hope you are enjoying playing Echoes III. Remember to unlock the Steam achievements within the game, they can help you in many ways.
